precondition: User is on the home page
steps: Step 1: Enter a valid search keyword into the search field
Step 3: Verify that the product list matching the keyword is displayed
expected_result: Product results relevant to the entered keyword are shown on the page

precondition: User is on the home page
steps: Step 1: Leave the search field empty
Step 3: Verify that all products in the store are displayed
expected_result: Full product catalog is shown after searching with an empty keyword

scenario: Search products with no matching results
precondition: User is on the home page
steps: Step 1: Enter a search keyword that does not match any product into the search field
Step 3: Verify that the message "Không tìm thấy sản phẩm nào khớp với lựa chọn của bạn." is displayed
expected_result: A no‑results notification message appears on the page
